CameraView.frigateNameHint: Must match the camera name in your Frigate configuration
CameraView.streamUrlHint: WebRTC/MJPEG URL from go2rtc or Frigate (e.g. http://frigate:8080/live/webrtc/api/ws?src=warehouse)
CameraView.frigateTooltip: Frigate is an open-source NVR (Network Video Recorder) with AI object detection. It connects directly to cameras via RTSP, analyzes the video feed in real time and detects persons, cars, animals etc. For each detection Frigate sends a webhook to the ERP — the ERP stores snapshot, clip and metadata and can trigger rules (notification, WhatsApp). The URL is required so the ERP can fetch snapshots and clips. Without Frigate: only a manual snapshot every 5 seconds, no automatic detection.
CameraView.frigateUrlHint: Base URL of your Frigate installation (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5000)
CameraView.hwCpuTooltip: The server's main processor. Intel chips have a built-in GPU (iGPU) that can be used for free AI acceleration.
CameraView.hwIgpuTooltip: The Intel UHD/Iris GPU is built into every Intel processor. It can accelerate YOLO object detection (person, car, dog) ~4x. Requires OpenVINO to be installed.
CameraView.hwOpenvinoTooltip: Intel OpenVINO offloads AI computations to the built-in Intel GPU. This makes YOLO ~4x and PaddleOCR (license plates) ~3x faster. Free, one click to install. Recommended for any Intel server.
CameraView.hwCoralTooltip: Google Coral USB Accelerator (~$35, Amazon) is a USB stick with a dedicated AI chip (TPU). It handles object detection entirely (~100 images/s) and almost completely offloads the CPU. Ideal for 10+ cameras. Plug in → install driver → done.
CameraView.hwYoloTooltip: YOLO (You Only Look Once) is the AI model for object detection. It recognizes people, cars, dogs, cats etc. in real-time. YOLOv8 nano (~6 MB) is the smallest model and runs even on weak hardware.
CameraView.hwInstallSuccess: {pkg} installed successfully. Restart camera monitor to activate acceleration.

CameraView.hwBackendCoral: Google Coral USB TPU — fastest option (~100 images/s). CPU barely used.
CameraView.hwBackendOpenvino: Intel iGPU via OpenVINO — good acceleration (~40 images/s). CPU partially offloaded.
CameraView.hwBackendCpu: CPU mode (YOLO) — works but slow (~10 images/s). CPU heavily loaded with many cameras.
CameraView.hwBackendNone: No AI backend available — motion detection only, no object recognition.
CameraView.hwRecommendOpenvino: Your Intel processor has a built-in GPU doing nothing. Install OpenVINO (free, one click) for ~4x faster object detection.
CameraView.hwRecommendCoralDriver: Google Coral USB is plugged in but the driver is missing. Click 'Install'.
